summary.name: Riverside
summary.one_liner: Riverside is an AI-powered online studio for recording, editing, repurposing, and distributing high-quality podcast and video content remotely.
keywords: podcast publishing to spotify apple youtube
use_cases: Recording remote podcast interviews with guests
Turning long recordings into social media clips
Hosting and recording webinars with registration and lead sync
Live streaming to LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitch and other platforms
Editing video by editing the transcript
Translating and dubbing content into other languages
summary.what_it_does: Riverside records local high-quality audio and video (up to 4K and uncompressed audio) in separate tracks, so output is not affected by internet connection quality. Its text-based editor lets users cut, copy, and paste within the transcript to edit video. AI features include filler word and silence removal, speech correction via transcript editing, eye contact correction, auto-layouts based on speaker, B-roll generation from prompts, and translation/dubbing into over 30 languages. The platform can generate transcripts, titles, descriptions, chapters, show notes and promotional assets, and publish to YouTube, Spotify and Apple. It also supports multi-destination HD live streaming with audience call-ins and built-in webinar registration.
notable: Separate-track local recording up to 4K video and uncompressed WAV audio, independent of internet connection
Text-based editor where editing the transcript edits the video
Multistream live to LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Twitch and more
AI features including eye contact correction, voice/lip sync correction, and dubbing into 30+ languages
caveats: Page says 'Start for Free' but does not detail which features require paid tiers
Business and team features are mentioned with priority support but no pricing is listed on the page
